body:
🎙️ Catch HOKO Live on Whatnot

Some of our best deals and live pack opens happen on Whatnot — where you can bid, snipe, and watch us crack packs in real time.

Live Thursday and Saturday, 7pm AEST.

Why we split it this way

This store = our full catalogue of singles, sealed product and graded slabs — browse and buy anytime, ready when you are.

Whatnot = live auctions, chase hits, and pack opens. $1 starts. No reserves. Real-time bidding.

What to expect on stream

  • $1–5 opening bids on most lots
  • Magic, Pokémon, One Piece, Lorcana and Japanese sealed
  • Live pack rips with real-time reactions
  • Combined shipping on multi-wins (Whatnot handles it automatically)
  • Dispatched within 3 business days, Monday to Friday

How to never miss a stream

Follow HOKO on Whatnot and turn notifications on. You'll get pinged the moment we go live — no need to keep checking back.

👉 Follow HOKO on Whatnot →

First time on Whatnot? Sign up is free and takes about 30 seconds.

New to live TCG auctions?

A quick rundown of how Whatnot streams work:

  • Watch live — Tune in via the Whatnot app or website
  • Bid live — Tap to bid, last bid wins when the auction closes
  • Win and pay — Whatnot processes payment automatically
  • Combined shipping — Win multiple lots, ships in one package

Where else to find HOKO

  • 🎵 TikTok: @hokocollectables — daily pulls, behind the scenes, deals
  • 📸 Instagram: @hoko.collectables — photos and stories
  • 🛒 eBay: ebay.com.au/str/hokocollectables — 315 ratings, 100% feedback

Questions?

DM us anywhere above or email support@hokocollectables.com. We reply within 24 hours.
